text:
Type: round ceramic bud vase
Use: holding single stems; living room, bedroom, dining room, on a shelf, table or nightstand
Style: bohemian, modern, coastal
Materials: ceramic with drip reactive glaze, unglazed speckled clay base
Colors: coral pink, white, tan
Shape: round bulbous body with narrow tall neck, dripping glaze bands, compact
Feel: cheerful, warm, artisanal
Goes with: light wood, blush and terracotta, white walls; boho or coastal rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Modern Round Ceramic Home Decor Flower Vase - 7 Inch, Coral White Tan
product.description: This uniquely beautiful vase will add a pop of color to your room, with or without a flower added. Bright coral is accented by drips of white. The bottom is left in an unfinished tan. Reactive glazing means no two are alike. 5.375"D x 5.375"W x 6.6"H Designed as a flower vase Ceramic porcelain Allow for variations in color
